definition: A constraint that is not left to your judgment and still carries no machine test, so nothing checks a house against it. Only a soft or advisory rule may stand so; a hard one must be tested or handed to you.
basis: build/check_constraints.py requires that "every hard constraint is either tested or explicitly scope: judgment", and fails any other with "either add one, or set scope: judgment with a reason"; the severity enum in schema/constraint.schema.json is hard, soft and advisory, so an untested rule outside judgment can only be soft or advisory. The same schema: a test is "Absent (not empty) otherwise -- absence is not a formalisation failure to hide, it is the honest state."
